test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B and C can complete a work in 12, 16 and 24 days respectively. B and C worked together for 4 days then C left the work and A replaced him. In how many days will the remaining work be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A = 12 days

Time taken by B = 16 days

Time taken by C = 24 days

B and C worked together = 4 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 12, 16 and 24 is 48

Efficiency of A = (48/12) = 4 units/day

Efficiency of B = (48/16) = 3 units/day

Efficiency of C = (48/24) = 2 units/day

Time taken by B and C together for 4 days = [4 × (3 + 2)]

⇒ (4 × 5) = 20 units

The remaining work = (48 – 20) = 28 units

Now,

Time taken by B and A to complete the remaining work = [28/(3 + 4)]

⇒ 28/7 days

⇒ 4 days

**∴ The required time is 4 days**
